fixes.detail: Softened an absolute claim about the actor to match the source's hedged wording.

open_issues.detail: The recommendation to force a password reset cites no passage in the source.

content.title: Coordinated credential-stuffing campaign against sector VPN gateways

summary.text: A campaign targeting VPN gateways across 37 organisations was recorded between 3 and 9 September.
The pattern of source IPs suggests a single coordinated actor rather than opportunistic scanning.

affected_systems.text: SSL-VPN gateways running unpatched firmware from before June 2026.

mitigations.text: Apply the vendor's September security patch immediately.
Force a password reset for all VPN accounts as a precaution.
